archetypes.name: dyn-oos-autofile
archetypes.rationale: OOS filing prompt contracts changed across design and legacy implement surfaces.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the changed OOS filing prose and harness assertions. Verify every accepted non-security OOS filing path now forbids confirmation and AskUserQuestion while security-routed OOS and skip or label-only branches remain excluded. Check that retry and manual recovery wording still preserves existing stdout capture, annotation, dependency-file, and failure-handling contracts. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
